name: ai.brownmatter/brainz
title: Brainz
description: Shared product-knowledge graph for AI agent fleets — vault tools + agent self-signup over MCP.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer bz_... vault API key (optional: clients that support MCP OAuth sign in instead). Without it, tools/list works and every tool call answers with an OAuth 401 challenge.

ai.brownmatter/brainz.signupFlow: Agents connect to https://brainz.brownmatter.ai/mcp/agent without Authorization and call signup {vaultName?, email?}; it returns {apiKey, vaultSlug, expiresAt, claimEmailSent}. The key works on /mcp and /mcp/agent. The workspace is provisional (7 days); persist it with the authenticated claim {email} tool, which emails your human an approval link. /mcp itself never hands out API keys.
ai.brownmatter/brainz.oauth: OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, client ID metadata documents). Protected-resource metadata: https://brainz.brownmatter.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp; one grant covers the vaults ticked at consent (one, several, or all including later ones); a multi-vault grant adds list_vaults and a required vault argument on every vault tool.
